comparison.objective: Insert an 18650 cell with correct polarity and screw a flashlight tail cap tight; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and insert a close-clearance cell, engage a multi-start thread, and regrasp through over 300 degrees versus coaxial break-off tooling and hammer impact.
comparison.success_condition: Cell positive-end first, cap centered and seated within 1 mm after sufficient rotation, all parts stable; no fracture or fragment containment.
comparison.reason: Tests polarity-sensitive insertion and threaded closure, not controlled fracture. All available versions retain those core requirements.
